name: State machine doc heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: maintainer doc; never loaded by the skill at runtime

name: Engine is the only writer
does: The engine is the single reader/writer of state files; the workflow acts only on its reports.
preventsClaim: the workflow applying state rules by hand

name: Engine commands heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Commands print JSON reports
does: All commands print a JSON report; the mise directory is the single working directory from the config.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Command table header
does: Table header row.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: report command semantics
does: report answers in_flight; when true it verifies hashes, computes next_action, and previews the write. Read-only.
preventsClaim: two pieces of work running at once

name: report --write persists
does: --write initializes the state file on a fresh start and applies the mismatch cascade.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: approve goals records route
does: Hashes goals.md and records approval plus route in one write; a goals approval without a route is unrepresentable.
preventsClaim: an approval whose route can be lost

name: approve stage cascades and clears
does: A changed re-approval deletes every later approval; a changed plan approval also clears done/.
preventsClaim: stale downstream approvals and re-running completed tasks
costNote: a changed goals re-approval re-runs every later stage and its critic loop

name: approve acceptance conditions
does: Records acceptance over every route artifact plus the done/ listing; fails unless all stages approved and tasks done.
preventsClaim: an acceptance surviving a later doc edit or task change

name: State file format heading
does: Section heading and JSON lead-in.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: State file example
does: Example state file with route and approved hash map.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: State fields and omissions
does: route, approved, and accepted are the whole file; completion lives in done/ and directory existence marks in-flight.
preventsClaim: a second source of truth for completion

name: Routes and hashes heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Route decides participating stages
does: The route decides which stages participate; recorded atomically with goals, unset behaves like direct.
preventsClaim: the route being lost while goals is approved

name: Route stage table
does: full adds mock; direct skips it; bugfix skips requirements too.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: bugfix drops one whole stage and one critic loop (up to 8 spawns)

name: Stage artifact table
does: Maps each stage to its artifacts; plan is hashed on 00_overview.md alone, so task edits never reopen it.
preventsClaim: task-file edits cascading the plan approval

name: Hashing and missing artifacts
does: SHA-1 of artifact bytes (mock: the concatenation); goals and mock stay separate entries; a missing artifact is a mismatch.
preventsClaim: a missing artifact erroring instead of reopening the stage

name: Done directory heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Done means moved and committed
does: Done exactly when the file sits in done/; IDs are the leading NN_NN, matched literally against the index.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: completion tracked in two places)

name: Done is scoped to plan version
does: done/ survives only a matching plan re-approval; any other clears it; unknown IDs are ignored.
preventsClaim: a stale done entry skipping work under a revised plan
costNote: a cleared done/ re-executes every task in the new plan

name: next_action heading
does: Section heading and evaluation-order lead-in.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Mismatch cascade reopens stages
does: The first hash mismatch deletes every later approval (reported as reopened); an unapproved stage deletes nothing.
preventsClaim: a later stage reviewed against a doc that has since changed
costNote: each reopened stage re-runs with its own critic loop

name: First unapproved stage is next
does: next_action is the first route stage not validly approved; artifact existence is never approval.
preventsClaim: a stage skipped because its artifact exists

name: Execute, acceptance, close_out
does: With docs approved, remaining tasks give stage:execute; all done gives acceptance, or close_out when accepted matches.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Acceptance triggers close-out sequence
does: Acceptance runs the pass, records confirmation, retrospective, deletes the directory, ships; an interrupted close-out resumes.
preventsClaim: a crash mid-close-out re-running the acceptance pass

name: Accepted record over-invalidates
does: The accepted hash covers every task-shaped done/ filename and only the mise directory, so it over-invalidates.
preventsClaim: an acceptance surviving work it never saw

name: Broken state heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Never rebuild state by inference
does: The engine never rebuilds state by inference; the user decides between git's copy and a fresh start.
preventsClaim: a guessed state file silently resuming the wrong stage

name: Fresh start condition
does: Missing state plus at most goals.md initializes empty state; --write persists it.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Anything else errors with options
does: Any other deviation errors, naming two options: restore from the last mise: commit, or delete the directory.
preventsClaim: a hand-edited or stale state file being trusted

name: Concurrency heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No locking across invocations
does: There is no locking across invocations: never point two sessions at the same mise directory.
preventsClaim: two sessions racing on one state file
